text:
Alex: Quick design check — proposing a compact "summary" affordance in Run History for structured/tool-call runs. Idea: a one-line collapse that shows intent + top-level tools used, with a chevron to expand details. mock: [img link] Marta: love the intent. Do you mean collapse by invocation or by top-level message? Alex: by invocation (each run). The summary line would include: user prompt snippet, status (success/error), tools used (icons), and a small "Inspect" button. Sam: accessibility question: keyboard focus needs to reach the Inspect button and expand region should be aria-expanded. Could we make the chevron button keyboard-only and allow Enter on row to expand? Julia: copy nit: "Inspect" feels heavy. What about "Details" or "Show steps"? Also we should avoid "Inspect" for privacy-conscious customers. Marta: +1 on "Details". Also we should show whether the structured output matched the schema (pass/fail) in the summary, maybe a small green/red pill. Alex: good call — add schema status pill. Proposed summary layout: [prompt snippet] • [Schema: pass] • [3 tools] • 324ms. On hover show full prompt preview. DesignBot: automated screenshot attached: playground-run-summary-proposal.png Sam: keyboard/voiceover: ensure the summary line announces the schema status and number of tools used. ARIA suggestion: role="button" for the row, aria-expanded="false" initially. Use live region to announce expansion. Alex: sample markup I sketched: ```
Summarize quarterly plan... Schema OK [tool1][tool2]
...detailed tool calls...
``` Marta: CSS/visual: we should keep summary height to single line with ellipsis and expose the full prompt on focus via tooltip; mobile should expand inline rather than open a side panel. Julia: run history noise concerns — if every run shows 1-line summary we might drown the timeline. Can we group repeated runs from same user or allow a condense-by-time toggle? Alex: thinking of two modes: compact (summary-only) and verbose (expanded). Default for power users could be compact. Add a "Group similar runs" option in settings. Sam: performance: expanding dozens of runs could load large JSON per run. Suggest lazy-load details on expand with a small spinner. Marta: copy proposal for the summary aria-label: "Run by {user}: {prompt snippet}. Schema {status}. {n} tools used. Press Enter to expand details." Thoughts? Julia: that's clear. Also change button text to "Details" and use visually-hidden prefix for screen readers: "Open run details for run at {time}". Alex: ok action list: 1) design -> produce final comp with compact row + expanded panel (Marta) 2) eng -> implement aria-expanded, lazy-load details, spinner (Sam) 3) copy -> finalize labels + tooltip text (Julia) 4) QA -> test NVDA/VoiceOver and keyboard flows. Marta: timeline? can we get comps by EOD tomorrow? I can do a quick pass then. Sam: dev can prototype the aria hooks today, I'll add a PR draft and link here. Julia: I'll drop a copy PR by noon. Small wording ask: replace "Schema OK" with "Matches schema" to avoid ambiguity. Alex: sounds good. One more UX nit — when a tool call returns a structured payload, show a miniature key-value preview inline (first 2 fields) so users can eyeball without expanding. Keep it subtle. Marta: agree but warn about PII; only show non-sensitive keys and mask values if flagged. DesignBot: flagged note: "consider PII masking policy for run summaries" added to thread. Sam: rough PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/run-history-summary-proto (WIP) Alex: thanks team — let's reconvene after comps. :thumbsup: Julia: :+1: Marta: assigning follow-ups in Asana. Sam: I'll run keyboard flow tests once PR lands. Alex: last: small analytics ask — track expand click, Inspect/Details click, and group toggle for defaults. Marta: added analytics event names in doc. DesignBot: reminder scheduled: design-review follow-up in 48h Alex: closing — good discussion.
